semiconductor_relevance: High — the company provides vacuum sealed feedthrough solutions specifically for semiconductor production equipment.
summary: Beijing CEC-TECH Co., Ltd. specializes in advanced vacuum feedthrough solutions for the semiconductor industry, offering innovative sealing processes that cater to various connector types. Their products are utilized in critical equipment such as lithography machines and scanning electron microscopes, earning positive feedback from customers.
capabilities: Epoxy resin sealing process for connectors
Custom sealing for various wire types

regional_presence.China: The company is registered in Zhongguancun Science Park, Beijing, and serves the local semiconductor market.
